title: Reading Drill — Comparing footbridge materials — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing footbridge materials — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The bridge technician in Elmbrook received an old report about bridge surfaces becoming smooth after repeated use. The report compared surface grip, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the portable slip tests rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered four weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include mud on footwear. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a textured deck coating as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
